page.layout: One printed page, text only. Running head at top centre (CONCIONES) with page number 132 at top left. Main text in two blocks: the end of the previous sermon's paragraph, then the heading block "CONCIO XVII." with "Deuter. 22.", followed by the text opening with a woodcut initial S at left. No marginal notes, no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Eædem filiæ interrogatæ à patre veritatē dixerunt: nec aufuetæ erant domum ducere (vt hodie nonnullę solent, inuitis & infci-is parentibus) viros ignotos & alienos: neqʒ id eas decebat. Ipsæ denique non nupserūt, priusquam pater illas elocauit nuptum. Vt & nos patris nostri cœlestis voluntatem in omnibus faciamus, adiuuet nos Dominus noster & saluator Iefus Christus, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO XVII. Deuter. 22.

p.i: I quispiam duxerit vxorem, accesseritqꝫ ad eam, & odio cœperit eam habere. Et im-posuerit ei data opera verba (mala) protuleritqꝫ contra eam nomen malum, vt si dicat: Cum duxissem mulie-rem illam, & ingressus essem ad eam, non inueni in ea signa virginitatis. Tollent pater puellæ atque mater eius, & profe-rent signa virginitatis puellæ ad senio-res ciuitatis, qui sunt in porta. Dicetqꝫ pater puellæ ad seniores: Hanc filiam me-am dedi viro illi in vxorem, cœpitqꝫ eam odio habere. Et ecce ipse imponit (ei) si-gmenta verborum, dicens: non inueni in filia tua virginitatem: hæc vero sunt si-gna

page.notes: Final word of the page, "gna", continues on the next page as "signa". The woodcut initial is a decorative S, read as the first letter of "Si quispiam". Two lines of the sermon heading and the text are set in italic type. The Latin "vt" and "ut" in the text are printed as "vt" and are normalised to "ut" per the u/v rule; the transcription keeps the printed form where a v-form is typographic. Readings of "si" and "signa" are marked by the scan and are not uncertain.
